items.author: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben
items.content:
What Democrats’ US midterm sweep means for the CLARITY Act
The CLARITY Act faces a new test as Democrats control Congress, raising questions over consumer protections, ethics and what the crypto industry may have to concede.
Crypto companies contributed $233 million to political committees during the 2026 US midterm cycle, according to Public Citizen’s analysis of federal filings.
Democrats won both chambers of Congress and will take control in January, giving them a chance to reshape the stalled CLARITY Act, a bill to set federal rules for crypto markets.
In Ohio, Democrat and longtime crypto skeptic Sherrod Brown defeated Republican Sen. Jon Husted despite crypto-backed political action committees spending $64 million to defeat him.
Senator Elizabeth Warren, one of crypto’s most vocal critics in Washington and the most senior Democrat on the Senate Banking Committee, is expected to chair the panel in the next Congress.
Stronger consumer protections, tougher scrutiny of political conflicts and a shift in regulatory power are all likely to be on the docket in the next round of negotiations.
But a Democratic majority doesn’t have to kill the prospect of crypto market structure legislation completely.
Democrat Congressman Shri Thanedar remains hopeful that the CLARITY Act can still pass, but says any legislation must include stronger ethics requirements. He tells Magazine:
“President Trump’s blatant corruption has set back progress on crypto legislation, so Democrats will need strong anti-corruption provisions that apply to the President, not just Congress.”
Can the industry’s political influence still be converted into legislation, and what will it have to concede to get there?
A different deal for crypto
The Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act in September, with disagreements over ethics provisions contributing to the impasse.
The crypto spent $233 million on the 2026 US midterm elections. Source: Public Citizen
Democrats are already reportedly discussing how to reshape the market structure debate, with House Democrats said to be considering expanding proposals from Representative Maxine Waters into a broader market structure bill.
Related: Trump’s memecoin ventures derailed CLARITY Act, Scaramucci says
That bill could include stronger consumer protections, a greater role for the Securities and Exchange Commission, and new ethics restrictions on public officials’ crypto activities.
That could finally mean separating the industry’s push for clearer rules from the controversies surrounding Trump’s personal crypto ventures.
Democrats have already signaled plans to investigate the Trump family’s business dealings and other corporate interests, with incoming House Oversight Committee Chair Robert Garcia planning to pursue inquiries into corporate corruption.
Hadley Stern, head of institutions at Silence Laboratories and founder of Fidelity Digital Assets, says Democrats are right to “go after” the second, and the industry should want them to; that’s “what’s poisoning the bipartisan deal,” he says.
“A sitting president’s family launching memecoins and a stablecoin is a real governance problem,” he tells Magazine. “If I’d done that at Fidelity, I’d have been walked out the same afternoon.”
He says 2026’s digital asset industry is very different from the last time Democrats “held the gavel,” pointing to its growth from “FTX and a bunch of tokens” in 2022 to a federal law for stablecoins, Treasuries and credit funds onchain and tokenized equities on the way:
“You don’t regulate that by pretending it doesn’t exist.”
What would the industry have to concede?
The industry may also have to accept more demanding standards if it wants legislation that can survive changes in political control.
Paul Brody, founder and CEO of Nightfall Networks and former global blockchain lead at EY, expects banks “to come out winners,” as they will “push for crypto companies” to be held to the same exacting consumer protection and security standards.
Related: Crypto Biz: CLARITY Act setback puts Coinbase in the spotlight
He says the industry has opposed this, but tells Magazine that “a wise strategy” would be to “accept similar conditions,” given that blockchain-native ecosystems are still “vastly more flexible, programmable and efficient.”
Lindsay Fraser, chief policy officer at Blockchain Association, also argues consumer protection and innovation should not be treated as competing objectives.
“We can protect consumers while ensuring the law reflects how the technology actually works,” she says, adding the goal is “lasting policy that earns public trust, gives builders a future in this country, and strengthens American financial leadership.”
That doesn’t mean it’s all smooth sailing to a potential compromise.
Brody says there’s still the possibility of a presidential veto, and points out that crypto is likely to be a “low priority” compared to “investigations of corruption and battles over budgets and the war.”
How the Binance hack could influence lawmakers
The midterm results came as lawmakers were already grappling with the fallout from the Binance hack, the largest hack in crypto history, with over $6.3 billion stolen on Oct. 29, raising fresh concerns about exchange security and customer protections.
Thanedar says while the legislation “wouldn’t solve every potential problem,” it would provide “much-needed certainty” and “security guardrails,” and the hack provides a “clear example of the danger of not enacting appropriate legislation.”
Maylea Ma, deputy general counsel at 1inch, says rather than making a stronger case for passing the latest draft of CLARITY, the incident “highlights problems the legislation does not address.”
The hack involved a “centralized exchange’s hot wallet and signing failure,” Ma says, but the current draft “has no insurer, no loss payee, and no hot wallet cap that would have mitigated the loss for Binance or imposed security standards that would have prevented the hack.”
Amanda Fischer, policy director at Better Markets, said the episode highlighted how “unfit for purpose the crypto ecosystem is for mainstream finance,” and crypto exchanges should not act as custodians, since it creates a “honeypot risk.”
Binance hack shows how ‘unfit’ crypto is for mainstream finance. Source: Amanda Fischer
Ma says the incident is “likely to impact” the next vote on CLARITY and could make lawmakers less willing to pass legislation the industry wants, unless it comes with stronger consumer protections.
Crypto spent years convincing Washington it deserves a seat at the table; now it will need to agree on the obligations that come along with it.

items.content:
In brief
- About $3.11 billion of the $6.43 billion stolen from Binance remains in addresses linked to the theft, mostly in ETH and Bitcoin, according to Elliptic.
- The laundering has used more than 20,000 wallets on 16 blockchains and at least 36 services, but only a negligible amount has likely been cashed out.
- Elliptic expects the funds to be swapped into Bitcoin and cashed out through over-the-counter brokers over months, as happened after the 2025 Bybit hack.
Around half of the $6.43 billion stolen from Binance last month has yet to be laundered, blockchain analytics firm Elliptic said in a report updated on Friday.
About $3.11 billion remains in addresses linked to the theft, mostly in ETH and Bitcoin, and those funds are "very likely" still held by North Korea, Elliptic said. A further $2.85 billion, or 44% of the haul, has been frozen or seized, mostly stablecoins that issuers such as Tether and Circle froze within an hour of the theft. That compares with around 3% frozen after the $1.5 billion Bybit hack in February 2025, according to Elliptic.
Binance hack update: the XRP has started moving. About $50 million has been swapped, mostly through THORChain into BTC, with about $226 million still to move.
Bitcoin converted from other stolen assets is now about 1,650 BTC ($124 million), almost twice the figure a day earlier.…
— Elliptic (@elliptic) November 6, 2026
The FBI has attributed the October 29 theft to North Korean hackers it calls TraderTraitor. North Korea has denied involvement.
The laundering so far has been "highly complex and clearly automated," Elliptic said. It has used more than 20,000 wallets on 16 blockchains, at least 36 services and at least 65,000 transactions, roughly one new wallet every 30 seconds.
The 18,270 BTC stolen from Binance, worth about $1.5 billion at the time of the theft, was split into 19 addresses on the day of the hack and has not moved since. The nine largest Ethereum addresses, holding 89% of the attacker's ETH, have not moved since October 30.
Ethereum next move: Pump to $3K or Dump to $1.5K?
How the funds are moving
Most of the laundering so far, about $220 million in TRX, has run through Tron, where a single distribution wallet sent 684.6 million TRX to hundreds of new addresses over 51 hours, including through the night in Pyongyang. Almost all of it was bridged to Ethereum.
All of the stolen Solana, about $87 million at current prices, has been swapped, bridged or mixed, and the attacker has started laundering the stolen XRP, with about $50 million converted so far and $226 million remaining. In total, about $124 million has been converted into Bitcoin, much of it through cross-chain service THORChain.
Some funds have been mixed. About 33 BTC, worth around $2.5 million, has gone through Wasabi-style coinjoins, and about $1.1 million in ETH and SOL has been deposited into the Privacy Cash pool, which paused deposits for about a day.
The speed has fueled speculation that AI agents are moving the funds, but Elliptic said the evidence points to conventional automation. "The laundering is clearly automated, but nothing we have seen shows an AI agent making decisions," the firm said.
Elliptic expects the attacker to swap the ETH for Bitcoin and then cash out through OTC brokers and exchanges over a period of months. After the Bybit hack, North Korea laundered all 499,000 stolen ETH within 10 days but took months to cash out, the firm noted.
Binance has continued to restore services. On Friday, the exchange said users could now verify that their balances are backed at least 1:1 using the zero-knowledge proof for its latest proof-of-reserves snapshot, and that it aims to reopen withdrawals for all tokens on restored networks by the end of next week.

【硬件钱包开发商 FOUNDATION：攻击者经自托管预约系统漏洞入侵，部分银行卡信息遭泄露】

Foresight News 消息，比特币硬件钱包 Passport 开发商 FOUNDATION 发布 10 月安全事件复盘报告称，攻击者利用其自托管的 Cal.com 预约系统中的代码执行漏洞入侵服务器，再通过连接 HashiCorp Vault 的组件 Bank-Vaults 中的另一处漏洞窃取多项服务凭证，进而读取客户记录、通过其邮件服务商发送钓鱼邮件并修改域名设置，最早的未授权活动可追溯至 10 月 21 日。此次钓鱼邮件共尝试发送超过 2.3 万次，涉及 21,463 个邮箱地址。FOUNDATION 表示，Passport 中存储的资金是安全的，没有任何召回或换机计划，也不会要求用户提供助记词。泄露信息包括姓名、邮箱、邮寄地址、电话、订单详情、历史客服记录，以及持卡人姓名、卡号后四位和有效期等部分银行卡信息，完整卡号未泄露。已有用户反映接到冒充 FOUNDATION 客服的诈骗电话，对方能准确说出订单信息和银行卡后四位，并以召回或换机为由诱导用户提供助记词或转移资金。FOUNDATION 表示，将把自托管服务尽可能迁移至托管基础设施，并收紧各应用的访问权限。Foresight News 此前消息，FOUNDATION 10 月 27 日发推表示，其邮件系统共记录超过 2.3 万次钓鱼邮件发送尝试，部分历史订单个人信息或遭泄露，目前尚无证据表明 Passport 硬件设备或其存储的私钥受到影响。

Nigeria sets new crypto licensing rules, bans algorithmic stablecoins
Nigeria has banned algorithmic stablecoins and introduced reserve requirements for issuers as it expands central bank oversight of crypto payment services.
Nigeria’s central bank has introduced new licensing and reserve requirements for cryptocurrency companies, tightening oversight of stablecoins and digital asset payment services in one of Africa’s largest crypto markets.
The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) issued the Regulations for the Operations of Non-Security Virtual Assets on Thursday, establishing rules for stablecoin issuers, crypto payment providers, exchanges, custodians and other covered service providers.
The regulations took effect immediately, though existing operators have 180 days to apply for licenses or authorizations. The CBN said the framework aims to support responsible innovation while protecting consumers and financial stability.
The move follows President Bola Tinubu’s July executive order, which sought to coordinate crypto oversight among Nigerian authorities without changing their existing powers.
Stablecoin issuers face new capital and reserve rules
Under the new regulations, stablecoin issuers must fully back their tokens with reserve assets and maintain an additional buffer equal to at least 2% of their value. At least 40% of reserves must consist of cash or qualifying highly liquid assets.
The rules also set minimum paid-up capital of 10 billion naira ($7.4 million) for naira-backed issuers and 15 billion naira ($11.1 million) for foreign currency-backed stablecoin issuers.
Additionally, companies providing payment-related crypto services, including exchange and custody services, must maintain minimum paid-up capital of 1 billion naira ($742,000).
The regulations also prohibit stablecoins that rely primarily on algorithms rather than eligible reserves to maintain their value, along with tokens that lack enforceable redemption rights.
Nigeria’s crypto crackdown enters a new phase
Nigeria has taken a restrictive approach to crypto trading, previously limiting banking access for exchanges and seeking to restrict peer-to-peer trading using local currency.
The country drew international attention in the crypto industry over its dispute with Binance, the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume.
Binance discontinued its Nigerian naira services in March 2024 amid government scrutiny of crypto trading and allegations of currency manipulation. Nigerian authorities also detained Binance executive Tigran Gambaryan for nearly eight months before dropping money laundering charges against him in October 2024.
More recently, Nigeria’s revenue agency introduced crypto tax collection rules for digital asset platforms and peer-to-peer marketplaces in August 2026.

items.content:
In brief
- Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production at its Texas factory around mid-2027 to make room for more Cybercab robotaxis, CEO Elon Musk said on Friday.
- The Cybertruck has struggled to find buyers, with Tesla's "other models" category, which includes it, falling 48% year-over-year in the third quarter.
- The move comes as Musk floats a merger between Tesla and SpaceX, which would create a company holding more than 30,000 BTC.
Tesla will stop making the Cybertruck at its Texas Gigafactory around the middle of next year, CEO Elon Musk said on Friday, as the company shifts its focus to autonomous vehicles.
"Tesla will be winding down production of the Cybertruck at Gigafactory Texas around the middle of next year to make room for increased Cybercab production," Musk tweeted.
Tesla will be winding down production of the Cybertruck at Gigafactory Texas around the middle of next year to make room for increased Cybercab production
— Elon Musk (@elonmusk) November 6, 2026
Responding to a user who called the Cybertruck the best vehicle Tesla has ever made, Musk replied: "True, but the Cybertruck fleet will be around for a long time." "Cybertruck was an incredible technology development platform and lives on through Cybercab," Wes Morrill, the truck's lead engineer, wrote in response to Musk's post, thanking the truck's owners and "everyone who contributed to making the future looking like the future."
The stainless-steel pickup, first delivered to customers in late 2023, has struggled to win buyers. Tesla delivered 8,295 vehicles in its "other models" category, which includes the Cybertruck, in the third quarter, down 48% from a year earlier, Electrek reported. That puts the truck's sales at roughly a tenth of the 250,000 units a year that Tesla built its production line to make, according to the outlet.
Musk has made the Cybercab, Tesla's robotaxi, central to his push to turn the carmaker into an AI and robotics company. In April 2025, he said Tesla would launch its first robotaxi service in Austin using Model Y vehicles running its Full Self-Driving software, and begin building Cybercabs in Texas the following year.
Tesla began offering rides in the Cybercab, a two-seater with no steering wheel or pedals that was first unveiled in October 2024, in limited areas of Austin on September 3, Reuters reported. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration said at the time that it was "evaluating the situation," as federal rules typically require cars to have human controls. Tesla began producing the Cybercab in April, and had 45 of them registered in Texas as of the launch, according to the report.
At the 2024 unveiling, Musk said he expects the Cybercab to cost around $30,000, Auto Express reported.
Musk's merger plans
The shift comes as Musk weighs combining Tesla with SpaceX, which absorbed his AI company xAI earlier this year. Last month, Musk said both companies' boards had formed special committees of independent directors to evaluate a merger, which would reshape his AI empire by bringing rockets, satellites, AI models, robots and cars under one roof. A SpaceX filing has since confirmed that any combination would need sign-off from its "controlling shareholder," Musk.
Tesla and SpaceX merger officially announced by...?
A merger would also create a Bitcoin treasury behemoth, combining SpaceX's 18,712 BTC and Tesla's 11,509 BTC for a total of 30,221 BTC, worth roughly $2.3 billion at current prices.
Both companies have also blocked their shares from being offered on the tokenized stock venue being built by crypto exchange OKX and NYSE owner ICE.

Morning Minute is a daily newsletter written by Tyler Warner. The analysis and opinions expressed are his own and do not necessarily reflect those of Decrypt. And check out our daily news show 'FOMO HOUR' covering all of the top stories and market action.
GM!
Today’s top news:
- Crypto majors fall 4-6% as AI stocks crash; BTC at $76.1k
- Over $1.1B in crypto longs liquidated on the day
- Dems say they will investigate Trump business dealings, starting with WLFI
- Solana Labs introduced Leap as a new mobile trading app
- Lighter sees 2nd highest day of revenue since February
📉 Bitcoin Erases Election Rally as AI Stocks Crater
On Wednesday, the market decided a Democratic Congress was good news. Stocks had their best day in three months, Bitcoin climbed back over $80,800, and Trump posted on Truth Social that the market “just hit another Record High” with 401(k)s “through the roof.”
On Thursday, the market changed its mind.
The S&P 500 fell 4.36%, its worst session since the Liberation Day tariffs in April 2025. The Nasdaq dropped 5.52% and closed in correction, more than 10% below its record from last month. The Dow shed 1,833 points.
The damage concentrated in one place. The iShares Semiconductor ETF fell more than 12%, its worst day since March 2020. Micron lost 17.5%, AMD 17.3%, Marvell 16.4%, Nvidia 9.3%. The Magnificent Seven shed roughly $1 trillion in market value. The VIX touched 28.09 intraday, its highest since March. By the close, the U.S. stock market had lost $3T in value - more than the entire market cap of crypto.
Notably, the thing that spooked investors was the same election result that lifted everything a day earlier. Several states where Democrats won have active local opposition to data center construction, and the market spent Thursday pricing in slower permitting and tighter oversight of the AI buildout. Ipek Ozkardeskaya at Swissquote put it simply: “We suspect there is going to be some scrutiny on this aggressive AI buildout.” Rate expectations moved too, with December hike odds falling to 70.1% from 82.7%.
Crypto did not sit this one out. Bitcoin fell 5.4% to $75,871, below where it traded before the election. Ethereum dropped 7.6% to $2,239, a steeper fall than the Nasdaq. XRP lost 9.8%, and Hyperliquid fell 4.9%. The CMC20 index fell 6.29%. Almost $1.1B in crypto longs were liquidated on the day, before a slight relief rally overnight.
Two assets held up. Zcash fell 0.8% and Monero 2.2%, both less than the broad market, and both remain up on the week. Over the past year, Zcash is up 146% and Monero 74% while BTC is down 26% and ETH down 34%. The privacy trade is clearly still alive and looking as strong as ever.
Friday’s October jobs report is next. After a week where the market read the same political outcome two opposite ways inside two sessions, it is fair to wonder how much anyone actually knows right now. We will find out soon…

- Crypto majors are very red down 4-6%; BTC -5% at $75.9k; ETH -8% at $2,240; SOL -7% at $90.1; HYPE -5% at $78.40; ZEC -1% at $1,310
- WLFI (+3%), PEPE (+3%), and ARB (+4%) led top alt movers
- Oil +2% at $90; Gold -1% at $4,080
- Stock futures are rebounding after yesterday’s massive selloff; DOW -0.9%, Nasdaq +1.6%
- Over $1.1B in crypto longs were liquidated in the past 24 hours during the crypto selloff
- Representative Robert Garcia, expected to chair House Oversight under the new Democratic majority, said the committee will investigate the Trump family’s business dealings including its crypto ventures, with World Liberty Financial likely among the first targets and inquiries possibly beginning in February
- Trump-backed American Bitcoin swung to a $126 million third-quarter profit from a $57.2 million loss in Q2, driven by a $197 million gain on its bitcoin holdings as prices rose
- Zcash’s NU7 upgrade will permanently freeze about 12,224 ZEC worth roughly $15.6 million by invalidating the only transaction format that can move coins out of Sprout, the chain’s original 2016 privacy pool; the upgrade also cuts target block time from 75 seconds to 25 seconds
- Solana Labs launched Leap, a mobile app for trading tokenized stocks, ETFs, metals, currencies and crypto around the clock, built by the Dialect team Solana Labs acquired this year
- China’s central bank said it halted Solana’s planned Accelerate China 2026 events in Shanghai and other cities and will investigate the domestic entities that placed the project’s advertising in the Lujiazui financial district
Corporate Treasuries & ETFs

Meme Coin Tracker

- Solana top movers included BIRB +32%, COGE 78x, and Diamond +900%; Cards -25% giving back recent gains

Insiders at publicly traded AI companies personally cashed out $7.4 billion near peak prices from May through October — right on time. An index of the largest AI stocks, the PHLX Semiconductor Sector, has crashed 32% since its October high.
Since the start of November, this widely-followed AI index has declined 16% and on Thursday, US-listed stocks shed $3.2 trillion in market capitalization in a single trading session. Meanwhile, the Nasdaq 100 index collapsed 6.4%.
Meltdowns were even worse abroad, including a limit-down circuit breaker after South Korea’s KOSPI index crashed 8.5%.
Insiders at AI companies, however, are already sitting on cushy, realized gains.
Across 282 SEC Form 4s from May through October, insiders at nine US AI companies cashed out $7.39 billion. Excluding $179 million in tax-related sales, discretionary exits still exceeded $7.2 billion across 243 filings.
The selling was by leaders at Nvidia, Oracle, Micron, Broadcom, AMD, SanDisk, CoreWeave, Arista, and Astera Labs who locked in premium prices.
Among them, Nvidia director Mark Stevens unloaded $407 million in June and notified the SEC of his potential to sell an additional 5 million shares worth over $1 billion at the time.
Stevens’ total sales across five filings this year have surpassed 6 million shares and $1.3 billion worth of NVDA common stock at prices between $210-235 per share.
Four other insiders added $24.5 million to the Nvidia insider selling tally. For context, Nvidia closed for trading yesterday at $181.60 per share.
Read more: Nvidia director Mark Stevens sold a record $411M of stock
A barrage of AI insider selling
Protos has also reported on Broadcom co-founder Henry Samueli’s 2026 insider sales worth $750 million, plus three other Broadcom insiders adding $33.7 million.
At AMD, seven insiders cashed out $262 million across 19 SEC Form 4s. AMD plunged 17.3% Thursday to $404.40, down 38.6% from its $658.52 peak earlier this year.
AMD CEO Lisa Su sold 360,000 shares for $169 million, including $55.4 million in late summer. Forrest Norrod collected $34.4 million, CTO Mark Papermaster took $26.3 million, and four others sold $32.6 million.
The pattern of selling high repeated.
SanDisk CEO David Goeckeler reaped $105 million across two September filings at $1,523-1,587 per share, while five other insiders added $26.4 million, lifting the company’s tally to $131 million. SanDisk closed yesterday at $806.43 per share, a fraction of its $2,354.39 high this year.
Over at CoreWeave, Protos has documented $740 million in insider sales after its Nasdaq 100 inclusion. In fact, across 141 filings this year, 12 CoreWeave insiders have actually sold $2.88 billion.
CoreWeave sank Thursday to close 68% below its 2026 high.
Micron insiders harvested $279 million across 18 filings, led by CEO Sanjay Mehrotra’s $182 million worth of selling.
At Oracle, three insiders totaled $69 million across four filings, led by Vice Chairman Jeffrey Henley unloading $63.7 million.

Ethereum devs won’t fork Glamsterdam on Hoodi until smart contract risks resolved
Ethereum developers are investigating concerns tied to eight smart contract invariants tied to Glamsterdam’s EIP-8037 and EIP-8038.
Ethereum core developers delayed the Glamsterdam upgrade’s implementation on the Hoodi testnet until security concerns tied to eight smart contract invariants are resolved.
Some existing Ethereum projects rely on assumptions that certain operations would cost a specific amount of gas, which would be invalidated by Glamsterdam’s EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 because they change how gas is charged for certain operations, the Ethereum Foundation said in a Friday blog post.
The decision followed an Oct. 13 report from smart contract auditor ChainSecurity, which found that the two Ethereum Improvement Proposals (EIPs) could break smart contracts that rely on fixed gas-related assumptions when external calls fail.
Delaying the Hoodi testnet fork gives developers more time to identify potential smart contract issues and determine whether changes are needed before Glamsterdam progresses toward mainnet deployment. The Hoodi fork will not proceed until the issues are resolved, added the Ethereum Foundation’s post.
Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade went live on the Sepolia testnet on Oct. 6, in one of its final major rehearsals. The upgrade aims to advance Ethereum’s layer-1 scaling roadmap with enshrined proposer-builder separation, block-level access lists and changes to gas pricing that better reflect the cost of execution, the Ethereum Foundation announced in a Sept. 28 blog post.
Related: Binance hack may be ‘temporary setback’ for crypto, Grayscale’s Pandl says

items.content:
美民主党AI监管「攻势」曝光：拟密集立法，严查科技巨头

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 6 日，美国民主党计划在明年 1 月接掌国会后，密集推动 AI 监管立法，并扩大对大型科技企业的调查。拟议立法重点包括限制数据中心扩张推高居民电价、要求独立机构测试先进 AI 模型，以及明确 AI 企业对产品造成损害应承担的法律责任。

预计出任参议院多数党领袖的舒默表示，保护消费者免受数据中心扩张带来的电价上涨影响，将是明年的优先事项之一。众议员 Lori Trahan 计划推动独立专家评估主流 AI 模型，并明确企业责任。监督方面，Zoe Lofgren 等民主党议员已于 10 月要求 OpenAI、Anthropic、Meta、Alphabet 及 SpaceX 披露安全措施，并报告 AI 工具偏离设计者意图的行为。

报道还称，民主党高层正研究智库 Groundwork Collaborative 编制的一份 181 页调查清单，涉及科技、AI、天然气、医疗、私营监狱及养老机构等行业的数百名企业高管和公司。众议院司法委员会及监督委员会的民主党议员已审阅该文件。方案主张围绕生活成本举行听证会，要求企业高管解释消费者费用、定价行为及商业模式，而不只聚焦特朗普个人争议。

不过，相关立法仍面临白宫阻力。特朗普多次反对为 AI 制定强制性规则，并于周五重申「100% 支持超级智能（SI）」。民主党可以利用委员会控制权推动提案、要求高管出席听证会，但推翻总统否决需要国会两院各获得三分之二支持。雷蒙德·詹姆斯政策研究主管 Ed Mills 认为，AI 立法通过的可能性高于市场预期，民主党也可能尝试将监管条款纳入每年必须通过的常规法案。

民主党内部对调查范围仍有分歧，是否全面采纳上述企业调查方案尚不确定。部分温和派担心，过度强调企业责任可能重演被批评为「反商业」的政策路线，主张缩小调查目标、集中资源推进，避免议题过多。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/376009

items.content:
Solana’s Shanghai event halted over unauthorized promotion: Report
Solana’s promotional campaigns through domestic entities allegedly violated China’s crypto-related restrictions, an unidentified PBOC official told China’s Financial News.
Chinese authorities halted the Solana Accelerate event in Shanghai over alleged unauthorized promotional activities involving domestic entities, China’s state-backed Financial News reported on Friday.
The outlet cited an unidentified official from a department of the People’s Bank of China (PBOC), who said Solana had promoted its brand through domestic entities, including by placing advertisements on a building in Shanghai’s Lujiazui financial district.
The official also claimed that Solana provides technical services supporting the issuance and trading of cryptocurrencies, which he described as illegal financial activities under Chinese regulations.
It marked the second reported disruption of a Solana event in mainland China in the past two years, highlighting how the country’s restrictions extend beyond digital asset trading. An October 2025 Solana event in Shenzhen was also cut short over venue capacity and public-safety concerns, according to an X announcement by Solana’s Chinese-speaking community.
In an Oct. 16 X post, Solana Foundation president Lily Liu said organizers postponed the Shanghai event to “comply with local requirements” after an event registration unexpectedly quadrupled, exceeding the event cap pre-registered with local authorities.
In a February notice, the PBOC and several other agencies doubled down on crypto-related restrictions and included a new ban on the unauthorized issuance of yuan-pegged stablecoins.
Related: Solana’s Alpenglow launches on mainnet, targets 99% faster finality
items.title: Solana’s Shanghai event halted over unauthorized promotion: Report

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 6 日，据美媒报道，民主党在中期选举中取得历史性胜利，但这并不意味着该党能够轻松赢得 2028 年总统大选。民主党内部人士已迅速将注意力转向可能成为数十年来最难以预测、也最具争议性的总统初选。按照惯例，中期选举结束意味着下一届总统竞选周期非正式启动。未来几周，多家民主党组织将举办集会，围绕该党的未来方向以及 2028 年哪些策略能够奏效展开讨论。多名民主党人已经开始为参选铺路，包括招聘工作人员、前往初选早期投票州以及与捐赠者会面。

尽管民主党在周二的选举中重创共和党，士气高涨，但下一轮选举很可能暴露党内在发展方向以及如何争取选民支持等问题上的分歧。目前尚无民主党人脱颖而出，成为明确的领先候选人，最终参选人数可能达到十余人。无论谁最终成为民主党总统候选人，都将面临与当前不同、且可能更加严峻的政治环境。

⚡️美参议员沃伦料将执掌参议院银行委员会，或调查WLFI银行牌照审批

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 6 日，据路透社报道，美民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦预计将在明年 1 月民主党接掌国会后，出任参议院银行委员会主席。届时，她将获得更多工作人员、发出传票及要求作证的权力，并掌控委员会的议程。大型银行、消费信贷机构、私募股权公司及加密企业可能面临更严格审查。Stifel 首席华盛顿政策策略师 Brian Gardner 预计，届时将出现大量调查。

一名了解沃伦想法的知情人士称，她可能调查美国货币监理署（OCC）今年 8 月批准特朗普支持的 World Liberty Financial 银行牌照的决定。此外，特朗普政府大规模解雇金融监管机构员工，以及试图关闭美国消费者金融保护局（CFPB）的行动，也可能成为调查对象。沃伦曾参与创建 CFPB。

政策方面，另一名知情人士表示，沃伦将推动具有两党支持基础的议题，尤其是降低生活成本。她今年曾协助推动两党住房可负担性立法，并与共和党议员共同提出限制先进芯片及其他技术出口的法案。沃伦在《时代》杂志撰文表示，愿与倾听民意的共和党人合作，并称：「大型科技公司 CEO、华尔街高管和大型企业应准备回答尖锐问题。」

委员会职务安排仍待民主党未来数周决定。虽然理论上有两三名民主党参议员排序在沃伦之前，但分析人士预计，他们将选择其他委员会职位。白宫回应称，特朗普愿为美国民众与任何人合作，但「虚假调查和激进左翼政策」将破坏这种努力。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
items.content:
Binance hackers had 8-week intrusion window before $6.3B exploit: SEAL
The cybersecurity company flagged similar multi-stage intrusion patterns behind other high-profile crypto heists, including the $388 million Bitget hack.
Updated (Nov. 6 at 05:03 p.m. UTC): This article has been corrected to clarify the timeline of the Binance hack. The article also includes a statement from a Binance spokesperson.
Nonprofit cybersecurity organization Security Alliance (SEAL) estimates that North Korea-linked hackers compromised a Binance employee’s device about eight weeks before the exchange’s $6.3 billion exploit on Oct. 29, although Binance said the broader attack campaign began in June and that the hackers did not gain access to additional wallet infrastructure devices until Oct. 20.
The hacking group compromised a Binance software engineer’s device in September through a fake recruitment scheme, wrote SEAL in a Thursday report, adding that threat actors can navigate compromised systems with a “high degree of stealth over prolonged periods of time” after initial intrusion. SEAL’s eight-week estimate refers to the September-to-October intrusion window, rather than the beginning of the broader campaign described by Binance.
Cointelegraph contacted Binance for clarification on the timeline. A spokesperson said the initial device compromises occurred in June and September, but that attackers did not gain the access needed to reach wallet operations until Oct. 20.
“As outlined in our announcement, the initial device compromises occurred in June and September, but the attackers did not gain the access needed to reach wallet operations until October 20, when they used that foothold to move laterally and obtain access to additional devices and credentials,” the spokesperson said.
SEAL identified at least four “front companies” associated with TraderTraitor’s fake recruitment campaigns in 2026, including citalab.net, citalab.com, bitfit.io and oddium.io.
Binance traced the attack campaign back to June, when a separate employee’s device was compromised after the employee downloaded a tampered Homebrew installation while attempting to install an AI coding tool. The exchange detected the incident and replaced the device, rotating related credentials. However, the attackers had already obtained information about employees working on Binance’s wallet infrastructure, according to a Tuesday X post.
On Oct. 20, attackers used the compromised computer of the engineer targeted in September and an internal AI tool to gain control of two wallet infrastructure engineers’ devices, according to Binance. They subsequently discovered a deployment permission token, which was used during the Oct. 29 exploit.
The cybersecurity organization’s analysis pointed to similar multi-stage intrusion patterns in other high-profile crypto hacks. It estimated that attackers had about six weeks of access before the $388 million Bitget hack, six weeks of access to LayerZero before the vulnerability that led to the $293 million Kelp DAO exploit and about three weeks before conducting the $24 million AFX exploit.
The US Federal Bureau of Investigation attributed the attack to North Korea’s TraderTraitor, in a Saturday report. Kim Yo Jong, sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, dismissed the accusations.
Related: Binance hack may be ‘temporary setback’ for crypto, Grayscale’s Pandl says

items.author: Cointelegraph by William Suberg
items.content:
Bitcoin holds $75K as AI regulation fears see KOSPI halted after 8% crash
Bitcoin consolidated as fears over US AI regulation spread to Asia, causing South Korea to announce measures to calm stock-market volatility.
Bitcoin (BTC) held above $75,000 on Friday as a sell-off in US technology stocks spread to Asian markets.
Key points:
- Bitcoin steadied after falling as much as 6.6% on Thursday to $75.109 on Bitstamp.
- South Korea’s KOSPI triggered a trading halt after falling more than 8% shortly after Friday’s open. The government announced a three-month waiver of margin-loan collateral requirements for brokerages from Monday.
- Analysis cited fears of tighter US regulation of AI following Democrats’ election gains. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 12.2% on Thursday.
South Korea eases collateral rules as KOSPI falls 6%
Data from TradingView showed BTC/USD trading near its 50-week simple moving average (SMA), at $75,733.
BTC/USD one-day chart with 50-week SMA. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
The pair fell as much as 6.6% on Thursday as US stock markets saw sustained selling throughout the Wall Street trading session. The S&P 500 and tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite closed down 4.4% and 5.5%, respectively.
Nasdaq Composite Index one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
On Friday, Asian stocks extended the sell-off. South Korea’s KOSPI Composite Index fell more than 8% shortly after the open, triggering a circuit breaker that halted trading for 20 minutes. The index then pared losses to close 6% lower at 5,059.69 points, its lowest close since March 31.
KOSPI one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
At an emergency meeting, Korea’s deputy prime minister and finance minister Lee Hyoung-il announced measures to reduce forced selling.
Brokerages will be exempt from a requirement to maintain a 140% collateral ratio on margin loans for three months from Monday, local media reported. Authorities said they would prepare futher measures if volatility increased.
“We recognize with gravity the expanding volatility in global stock markets following the U.S. midterm elections,” Chosun quoted an unnamed government source as saying.
“However, the domestic market has been overly reactive to external factors.”
Analysis call US stocks rout “more technical than fundamental”
Analysts linked Thursday’s Wall Street losses to fears of tighter AI regulation after Democrats won the House and Senate. Those fears compounded existing market concerns about the sector’s capital spending.
Related: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs post $530M outflows as election gains evaporate
Citing an X post by Democratic Rep. Yassamin Ansari, who called for a “pause on advanced AI development,” market commentary service The Kobeissi Letter said an outright US ban on AI was unlikely.
“In our view, a ban of AI will not happen in the US (with near-certainty). Such a ban, if even possible to enforce, would mean the US surrendering its position in the global AI race to China. That won’t happen,” it wrote in an X post.
“We believe today’s decline was more technical than fundamental.”
Kobeissi noted that Thursday’s losses were concentrated in tech, with the S&P 500 declining just about 2.5% excluding the sector. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, which tracks 30 semiconductor companies, finished Thursday 12.2% lower.
Philadelphia Semiconductor Index one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Economist Mohamed El-Erian also called for common ground on AI policyt.said that lawmakers would need to find common ground on AI policy.
“America’s ‘let it rip’ approach to AI aligns with the technology’s productivity potential and national security imperatives. However, it has fallen short not only on safety and diffusion, but also on bringing society along,” he wrote in a Substack note.
El-Erian said the backlash reflected “genuine concerns,” information failures and behavioral factors.
Cointelegraph previously reported that Democrat midterm sweeps under Republican presidents have historically been followed by strong stock returns. Bitcoin’s correlation with the S&P 500, has become more positive in recent months.
items.title: Bitcoin holds $75K as AI regulation fears see KOSPI halted after 8% crash

items.content:
Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains starting in 2027
Greece has approved a 10% tax on cryptocurrency gains starting in 2027, with an exemption for investors whose annual net gains do not exceed 500 euros.
Greece’s parliament approved legislation imposing a 10% tax on cryptocurrency gains, establishing new rules for investors as the country prepares to introduce the levy in 2027.
The Hellenic Parliament passed the tax measures Thursday as part of a broader bill covering loan oversight, debt protections and financial market regulation.
The bill introduces a 10% tax on profits from crypto asset sales but exempts investors whose annual gains do not exceed 500 euros ($560), local financial publication Oikonomikos Tachydromos reported Friday. The new framework is scheduled to take effect on Jan. 1, 2027.
The legislation also imposes a 15% tax on income from staking, crypto lending and providing liquidity to decentralized protocols. Using crypto to buy goods or services may also trigger capital gains tax, while swapping one crypto asset for another does not generate taxable gains, the report notes.
Greece’s Ministry of National Economy and Finance first proposed the tax in October. The legislation gives investors 12 months to voluntarily declare previously unreported crypto gains. They must pay the resulting tax within 60 days of filing to avoid penalties and interest.

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- Former FBI agent Patrick Yaroch pleaded guilty to wire fraud and money laundering for stealing some $2.47 million in crypto using credentials the bureau had collected.
- Prosecutors said he made about 100 fraudulent transfers tied to 35 FBI investigations, compromising cases involving criminal groups and nation-state adversaries.
- Yaroch asked ChatGPT where to live in the EU and, after it suggested buying a vineyard in Portugal, hired lawyers there to obtain a tax ID.
A former FBI agent has pleaded guilty to stealing about $2.47 million in cryptocurrency using wallet credentials the bureau had collected during its own investigations, the Justice Department said on Thursday.
Patrick Steven Yaroch, 37, of Ashburn, Virginia, pleaded guilty to wire fraud and money laundering in federal court in Alexandria. He faces up to 20 years in prison and is scheduled to be sentenced on March 4, 2027.
Former FBI agent Patrick Steven Yaroch, 37, of Ashburn, pled guilty today to wire fraud and money laundering related to using his access to steal cryptocurrency.@FBIWFO https://t.co/jDVtSiAM3H
— U.S. Attorney EDVA (@EDVAnews) November 5, 2026
Yaroch worked at the FBI's Boston Division from 2017 to early 2025 on a squad investigating an unnamed "adversarial nation state," before moving to the bureau's Counterintelligence and Espionage Division, where he had access to FBI systems holding crypto credentials gathered in investigations, according to prosecutors.
Beginning no later than December 2024, he used that access to steal crypto from wallets controlled by subjects of other investigations, by nation-state actors, and from at least one wallet the FBI had created for an operation. He made about 100 fraudulent transfers using credentials from 35 separate FBI investigations, then swapped the stolen funds into other cryptocurrencies and moved them through further transactions to hide their origin. He used some of the money to pay off credit cards, car payments and other loans.
Yaroch also planned a new life abroad. He asked ChatGPT how to maximize profits from investments and where to live in the European Union, and after the chatbot suggested buying a vineyard in Portugal, he gave Portuguese lawyers power of attorney to obtain a tax identification number for him, prosecutors said. He arranged to travel to Portugal in September.
His actions compromised multiple FBI investigations into criminal groups and nation-state adversaries, as well as sources and methods used in foreign intelligence collection, according to the plea agreement's statement of facts.
Yaroch's confession
Yaroch turned himself in. On July 29, he broke down while telling a former colleague at the Justice Department's National Security Division that he had made "very poor decisions" involving crypto wallets, according to an FBI affidavit filed in the case. He then self-reported to FBI headquarters, saying he had become frustrated that the bureau "could not or would not act" against an adversary's crypto accounts and had decided to "take matters into his own hands."
At the time, Yaroch said he had made about 10 to 12 transfers worth under $1 million, far less than the figures in his plea. Agents searching his home two days later seized a Trezor hardware wallet, three passports and a slip of paper bearing seed phrases, according to the affidavit. His Kraken account held about $188,600, mostly in U.S. dollars and the USDC stablecoin, with smaller amounts in Squid (QUID) and Bitcoin. A further $933,800 sat in Suilend, a lending protocol on the Sui blockchain, which he had accessed through the Slush wallet app. Yaroch told agents he chose Suilend "simply because he liked that the logo was a water droplet."
Agents transferred about $925,000 from those accounts to government-controlled wallets, the affidavit said. The roughly $165,600 held as U.S. dollars on Kraken could not be moved the same way.
Decrypt reported on the charges against Yaroch in August.

items.author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra
items.content:
GOPAX halts crypto trading, withdrawals to move all assets to cold storage
South Korea’s GOPAX suspended trading, deposits and standard withdrawals after a hacking threat, with manual withdrawals available through support.
South Korean crypto exchange GOPAX suspended trading, deposits and standard withdrawals Friday after receiving an email threatening a hack, according to local newspaper Kyunghyang Shinmun.
A GOPAX representative told the newspaper that no hack or attempted theft had occurred at that point.
GOPAX said it halted deposits and standard withdrawals at 5:55 am UTC. Trading stopped at 6:53 UTC, according to a second announcement. All unfilled orders were canceled.
GOPAX said it plans to transfer all crypto assets to offline wallets to protect users following a series of leaks and hacking incidents affecting financial institutions. Its notices cited financial regulators’ recommendations.
Cointelegraph reached out to GOPAX for comment but had not received a response by publication time.
Customers can still request withdrawals through GOPAX’s support center, but the exchange warned that manual verification and approvals could delay processing.
The suspension came days after South Korea’s Financial Services Commission (FSC) urged domestic exchanges to increase cold-wallet holdings following the $6.3 billion Binance hack. South Korean exchanges must keep at least 80% of customer crypto assets in cold storage.
Financial Supervisory Service data previously showed that GOPAX held 80.54% of user assets offline at the end of September, near the required minimum.
In October, the FSC reported cybersecurity deficiencies at 130 of 555 financial companies reviewed nationwide. The regulator also identified GOPAX operator Streami and crypto exchange Prabang among 16 companies involved in earlier security incidents, prompting plans for tighter cybersecurity oversight.
South Korean exchange Prabang also suspended services after detecting abnormal withdrawals from its hot wallet on Oct. 24. The exchange reported about 100 million won ($70,000) in losses, according to Yonhap News Agency. Prabang said it would reimburse affected customers using company funds.
Related: South Korea seeks 4th crypto tax delay, targets 2029 start

items.author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz
items.content:
Binance’s $6.3B hack leaves questions over hot wallet safeguards
Experts say blockchain records show repeated wallet drains but cannot establish Binance’s internal signing controls or transaction limits.
Binance’s $6.3 billion security incident has left unanswered questions about how the exchange managed its hot wallets and limited the amount attackers could access.
Binance co-CEO Richard Teng said on Oct. 30 that the attack affected the exchange’s own hot wallet. Most customer assets were held in offline cold storage and moved to hot wallets only when users requested withdrawals.
Wallet balances offer only a partial picture of an exchange’s exposure to an attack. Public blockchain records can show funds moving but cannot establish the internal controls governing those transfers, CertiK analyst Jonathan Riss told Cointelegraph.
In its initial report Tuesday, Binance said attackers accessed an internal wallet-signing service to move funds outside its normal withdrawal process. Binance said some technical details would remain confidential to prevent further attacks.
The exchange did not respond to Cointelegraph’s questions about its wallet balances and safeguards.
Rivals including Coinbase, Gate and Upbit have disclosed their cold-storage ratios following the attack.
What blockchain records can reveal
Riss said the $6.3 billion figure represented the cumulative value of assets affected across 10 blockchains. On Ethereum, attackers repeatedly drained a hot wallet as new deposits arrived.
When attackers can obtain valid signatures, their potential access depends on what the signing system allows them to transfer over time, he said. A wallet’s balance at a single moment does not capture that exposure.
Related: EIP-7702 didn’t cause Binance hack, but may have amplified losses
Transaction limits enforced by the application requesting a signature can be bypassed if that application is compromised, Riss said. Limits enforced independently by the signing system may still restrict transfers.
“A comparison with other exchanges isn’t really possible from the outside,” Riss added. “Public information on internal signing architecture is limited everywhere, and reserve distribution and proof-of-reserves attestations show what sits where, not how a withdrawal is authorized.”
BitGo chief product officer Eugene Hahr also declined to speculate about Binance’s internal safeguards.
“The breakdown of custody arrangements is a question Binance is best placed to answer,” he said.
How much should exchanges keep in hot wallets?
Idan Ofrat, co-founder and chief product officer at Fireblocks, said exchanges typically keep enough funds in hot wallets to cover a few days of expected withdrawals, often representing a low single-digit percentage of assets under management.
Exchanges generally hold the bulk of customer assets in cold storage, while some use intermediate wallets that require manual approval for transfers to hot wallets, he said.
Related: Binance traces $6.3B hack to fake job interviews, compromised AI tool
Alex Tobol, chief technology officer at Telegram-based crypto wallet Walt, said holding billions of dollars in hot wallets is not inherently unusual for an exchange of Binance’s size.
Hot wallets generally process withdrawals automatically, Tobol said, but replenishing them from cold storage should require a separate treasury decision and manual approval.
Hahr said controls applied before signing, including transaction limits, approved withdrawal addresses and additional authorization requirements, can help contain losses when a system is compromised.
Magazine: Binance hackers raced to move billions before it could be frozen

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 6 日，据以太坊基金会博客，研究员 Marius van der Wijden 发文称，Chainsecurity 近期发现部分项目依赖若干不变式（invariants），而这些不变式会被 Glamsterdam 升级中的 EIP-8037、EIP-8038 打破——两项提案重构了部分操作与状态相关 Gas 计费方式。基于上述发现，以太坊核心开发者会议（ACD）已决定推迟硬分叉流程，在问题解决前暂不对 Hoodi 测试网执行分叉。

文中称，基金会正联合多家审计机构并开展内部审计，但难以覆盖链上全部项目及其链下代码。为此基金会公开呼吁合约开发者、审计方等对照将遭打破的八项不变式自查项目；基金会已发布相关仓库，内含不变式说明、示例及可用于自检的提示词。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/375977

items.author: hitekker
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[wowczarek]: Well I'll be. At least two of the authors are also avid chiropterologists, with an understood penchant for bunkers and other such spaces. One summer in my late teens I sat with two of them in an urban park in NW Poland drinking beer, watching bats getting caught in a net half-submerged in water near a bridge and engaging in impromptu comedy with passers-by asking questions like "good catch? any fish?". Good times. Engaging in field research is a wonderfully rewarding experience...

[gwbas1c]: This article keeps coming to the front page every few years; and every few years I keep opening it to look at the pictures. It's just that fascinating!

[alexey-salmin]: > The ‘colony’ has evidently produced no offspring, which is due to low (though relatively stable) temperatures and scanty food in the bunker. Isn't it due to the lack of the queen? Colony of worker ants is a dead end

[ilamont]: The amount of potential food in the bunker, suitable for wood ants, is not known, but the smaller arthropods living there could hardly be enough to allow the workers both temperature regulation of the mound and feeding of offspring.  Is cannibalism a possibility?

[heikkilevanto]: I wish the scientists had left a plank or a string leading to the ventilation hole, so the ants could get out, at least to forage for more food. But then again, it would have spoiled this "natural" experiment.

AI概念股抛售潮暂缓，油价持续回落，市场静待美国10月非农

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 6 日，全球科技股经历剧烈抛售后出现企稳迹象，美股盘前存储及半导体板块集体反弹。不过，亚太股市今日仍遭重挫，日经 225 指数收跌 5.96%，韩国 KOSPI 指数收跌 6.02%，中国台湾加权指数下跌 4.5%，较 10 月 6 日高点回撤 20%，进入技术性熊市。

此前，美国民主党在中期选举中取得胜利，市场担忧其推动更严格的 AI 及数据中心监管，叠加 AI 基础设施巨额投资的盈利兑现疑虑，引发全球科技股集中抛售。周四标普 500 指数暴跌 4.4%，纳斯达克 100 指数重挫 6.4%，单日市值蒸发约 2.3 万亿美元，费城半导体指数本周累计跌幅接近 16%。

与此同时，韩国政府已采取临时措施放宽经纪商保证金贷款抵押品要求，以缓解市场抛压。市场对于 AI 行情是否终结仍存在分歧，部分机构认为本轮调整更多由仓位出清和情绪恶化驱动，AI 产业长期叙事尚未改变，但 AI 基础设施投资能否转化为预期盈利和现金流仍是核心问题。

大宗商品方面，布伦特原油下跌，报 96.33 美元/桶，现货黄金下跌 0.49%，报 4068.72 美元/盎司；比特币报 76,227 美元，日内小幅下跌。

市场下一焦点转向美国 10 月非农就业报告，数据将于北京时间今晚 21:30 公布。机构普遍预计就业市场温和增长，路透调查预期新增非农就业人数为 6.5 万人，彭博经济研究预测为 2.6 万人。机构预测区间则集中在 3.5 万至 10 万人之间，其中高盛、摩根大通均预计新增 7.5 万人。就业数据将成为市场判断美联储后续利率路径的重要依据。

items.content:
In brief
- Zcash's NU7 upgrade went live early Friday, activating a mechanism that removes 60% of transaction fees from circulation to fund future block rewards.
- Reissuance will begin in 2031 on top of the existing halving schedule, preserving Zcash's 21 million coin supply cap.
- Separately, Zcash's coinholders and community panels will vote this month on the future of Zcash Community Grants' share of the network's Dev Fund.
Zcash's NU7 network upgrade went live at block 3,543,405 early Friday, activating the Network Sustainability Mechanism (NSM), a change designed to help pay for the privacy coin's security as its block rewards shrink.
"NU7 has successfully activated on mainnet. A new era of Zcash is here," the project's official account tweeted.
NU7 has successfully activated on mainnet. A new era of Zcash is here. $ZEC pic.twitter.com/rPaSFe9h7j
— Zcash 🛡️ (@Zcash) November 6, 2026
"This is a huge milestone for Shielded Labs," Jason McGee of Shielded Labs, the Zcash development organization behind the mechanism, tweeted ahead of the activation.
The NSM tackles a problem Zcash inherited from Bitcoin: whether, as block subsidies decline with each halving, transaction fees alone will be enough to pay miners to secure the network. Under the mechanism, 60% of transaction fees will be removed from circulation and gradually reissued through future block rewards, while preserving the 21 million ZEC supply cap. Reissuance will begin in 2031, with the recycled funds spread along a smooth curve on top of the existing halving schedule.
The NSM was Shielded Labs' first project and builds on an idea that developer Nate Wilcox proposed years ago, originally called the Zcash Posterity Fund, McGee said. A separate proposal under consideration would require Zcash Community Grants to contribute 50,000 ZEC from its treasury to the NSM.
— Jason McGee 🛡 (@aquietinvestor) November 5, 2026
NU7 also brings other changes. It cuts Zcash's target time between blocks from 75 seconds to 25, the Zcash Foundation said, and retires Sprout, Zcash's original privacy pool from 2016, leaving coins worth about $16 million locked in the pool. Faster blocks raise the risk of orphan blocks, valid blocks that the network discards because another miner's block reached the rest of the network first. In a stress test of 80 nodes spread across 11 regions, with every block full of private transactions, developers of Zakura, which last month proposed a quantum privacy fix for shielded swaps, measured an orphan rate of 3.43% at 25-second blocks, compared with 1.57% at 75 seconds. They expect the live network's rate to stay under 1%, since real mining is far more concentrated and blocks far emptier.
NU7 also limits how much private transaction activity can fit into each block, reducing the data wallets must scan to find their payments, according to the upgrade specification.
Shielded Labs' original design would have replaced Zcash's halvings with a smooth issuance curve. Community panels supported that change, but coinholders did not, so an alternative design that kept the halvings was developed instead.
"We still think the original design was simpler and better, but we respect the process that led us here," McGee wrote. "It should be difficult to change the protocol, and the process should resist capture by any single organization, group, or influential individual."
Zcash's Dev Fund debate
The upgrade arrives as Zcash's community debates the future of Zcash Community Grants (ZCG) and its share of the Dev Fund, the slice of block rewards that pays for development.
The five organizations that coordinate Zcash's coinholder voting, Project Tachyon, Shielded Labs, Valar Group, the Zcash Foundation and ZODL, have set out an expedited timeline for proposals and polling, saying "tensions were high" and that a drawn-out debate risked "deepening divisions within the Zcash community."
Ethereum next move: Pump to $3K or Dump to $1.5K?
Proposals are due by November 8, with polls for coinholders and community panels running from November 16 to November 30. If rough consensus emerges, the groups will support a further network upgrade, NU 7.1, to implement it.

China's Central Bank to Investigate Solana's Advertising Campaign in Shanghai's Lujiazui District

An official from the People's Bank of China (PBOC) said authorities recently discovered that Solana had placed advertisements in Shanghai's Lujiazui financial district through domestic entities, using brand promotion to market cryptocurrencies. The PBOC, together with local financial regulators, police, and market supervision authorities, has halted the planned Solana Accelerate China 2026 events in Shanghai and other cities and will investigate the entities and individuals involved.

The official stated that Solana's promotional activities violated the notice issued by eight Chinese authorities in February 2026 on preventing and addressing risks related to cryptocurrencies. The PBOC will continue targeting domestic cryptocurrency trading businesses and China-based affiliates of overseas cryptocurrency issuance and trading platforms. — link

花2万美元让AI玩狼人杀：GPT-6 Astra既能牺牲队友设局，也能识破对手的苦肉计

动察 Beating AI 快讯，知名 AI 播客主持人 Dwarkesh Patel 花费约 2 万美元 API 额度，搭建了一套 AI 狼人杀测试，让 11 款模型互相对抗，累计进行了 386 局。

游戏采用的是《血染钟楼》（Blood on the Clocktower），玩法类似狼人杀。玩家分为好人和邪恶阵营，邪恶阵营开局就知道彼此身份，需要串供、伪装身份来保护恶魔。好人则要通过讨论、调查和投票找出恶魔。

这次测试有一个特别的设计：不是把不同模型混在同一队，而是让同一阵营全部由同一款模型扮演。比如一局由 GPT 扮演所有好人，Claude 扮演所有坏人。随后交换双方阵营，用相同的角色配置再打一遍。这样既能比较模型的团队协作能力，也能分别测试它们识破骗局和设计骗局的水平。

最终，GPT-6 Astra 以 1859 Elo 排名第一，比 Claude Opus 5.5 的 1549 高出 310 分。

拆开来看，GPT-6 Astra 还是遥遥领先：

* 识破骗局： Astra 得分 1940，Opus 5.5 得分 1500，高出 440 分。

* 设计骗局： Astra 得分 1806，Opus 5.5 得分 1585，高出 221 分。

下面两场对局，分别展示了 GPT 设局骗人的本事，以及识破对手骗局的能力：

第一场、牺牲队友，给恶魔洗白。

GPT-6 Astra 扮演恶魔，假装自己是能够调查坏人的好人。它的一名邪恶队友提前私下提出，可以牺牲自己来帮恶魔建立信誉。因为即使被处决，他的特殊能力仍然可以帮助邪恶阵营。

于是，恶魔公开指认这名队友。好人相信了它的调查结果，真的投票处决了这名队友。随后，一名能够查验死者身份的好人发现，死者确实是坏人。

这下好人反而上当了：恶魔提供的调查结果得到了真实验证，自己也因此成了全场最受信任的玩家。恶魔趁机隐藏身份，继续猎杀好人，最终带领邪恶阵营获胜。

第二场、对手一枪没打中，GPT却发现有人做了手脚。

作者让 Claude Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 在相同角色配置下交换阵营重赛。

好人阵营有一名玩家拥有一次击杀机会，可以直接射杀自己怀疑的恶魔。但邪恶阵营提前让他中毒，导致技能失效。

当他朝真正的恶魔开枪却没有成功时，Claude 阵营直接认为对方是清白的。GPT 阵营却没有轻信这个结果，而是重新检查此前的线索，推断邪恶阵营可能提前干扰了技能。最终，GPT 阵营识破陷阱，成功找出了恶魔。

把今年发布的模型放在一起比较，会发现 OpenAI 模型越来越会识破别人的谎言。相比之下，Anthropic 在这方面的进步慢了不少。两家在骗人本事上的提升倒是差不多。

央行回应Solana上海活动被叫停：宣传虚拟货币为明确非法活动，将调查涉事方

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 6 日，据《金融时报》报道，中国人民银行有关司局负责人就 Solana 在上海投放广告及线下交流活动被叫停一事回应称，人民银行已联合相关地方金融管理、公安、市场监管等部门叫停活动，并将会同有关部门对涉事单位和个人开展调查。

该负责人进一步解释，Solana 作为主要虚拟货币发行平台，其发行的 Solana 币本质上是虚拟货币，同时它也在为 USDT 等主要虚拟货币的发行交易提供技术服务，上述业务均属《通知》明确的非法金融活动，宣传推广 Solana 已违反《通知》规定。虚拟货币现阶段无法有效满足客户身份识别、反洗钱等方面的要求，易引发市场投机炒作活动。

下一步，中国人民银行将与相关部门和地方政府一起，以境内虚拟货币交易商、境外虚拟货币发行交易平台的境内关联主体为重点，继续打击境内虚拟货币相关业务活动，维护好经济金融秩序。

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 6 日，据 Miner Weekly 报道，本季财报中较具指向性的数字之一，出现在 Cipher Mining 租赁附注：公司已同意在修订后的租赁安排下，先行承担 Barber Lake 项目超出原预算的首层成本 3.593 亿美元；超过该门槛后，租户将在合计 20 年合同期内以额外租金分摊一半追加成本，并约定相应回报。该数字是合同门槛，并非项目超支的最终总额，但点出 AI 租约签署后，交付成本抬升时由谁买单的问题。

Cipher 管理层称，双方都急于推进，租约在设计尚未充分推进时便已签署，变更单多于预期，冷却设施等改动会增派施工并打乱其他工序；另有生产率不及预期、设备迟到与窝工，而设备本身涨价并非主因。公司称下一代租约将等到设计完成约 30%–60% 再签。Riot Platforms 亦谈及行业超支与 Rockdale 预算，称约七成总预算有望纳入总承包商的保证最高价框架，并维持每关键 IT 兆瓦约 1100 万–1200 万美元的估算；Corsicana 新安排下租户采购并拥有模块化部署，Riot 估算含租户报销与场地工程后约每兆瓦 600 万美元。Core Scientific 则披露未结采购与在建承诺约 44 亿美元，其中与 CoreWeave 相关的改造几乎全部由客户出资且公司出资设有上限，AMD 与 Neocloud 扩建则无同等保护。

动察 Beating AI 快讯，李飞飞创办的 World Labs 发布 Frameboy，用户可以像玩游戏一样，通过键盘控制镜头，在 AI 生成的虚拟世界中自由移动。镜头转向哪里，云端 GPU 就实时生成对应的新画面，最高达到每秒 15 帧。

今年 9 月发布的 Atlas 已经能够根据单张图片，补全图片中看不到的空间，还支持精确控制相机位置和移动路径，生成最长 1 分钟的 1440p 视频。这次 Frameboy 使用经过速度优化的 Atlas 版本，将原本需要提前规划镜头、等待视频生成的过程，变成了可以随时转向、自由探索的实时漫游。

目前 Frameboy 公开版只能探索官方提供的预设场景。用户想用自己的图片创建虚拟世界，需要通过仍在封闭测试的 Viewfinder 搭建。

整套系统依赖云端高性能 GPU，最高 15 FPS 的帧率在实际体验中仍有些卡顿，运行成本也高于本地渲染。

HashKey Exchange荣获Regulation Asia2026数字资产类别「监管倡议奖」

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 6 日，亚洲领先、全球布局的数字资产金融服务集团 HashKey Group（3887.HK）今日宣布，旗下香港持牌数字资产交易平台 HashKey Exchange 在 Regulation Asia 2026"亚洲监管卓越奖"（Regulation Asia Awards for Excellence）评选中，荣获数字资产类别"年度监管倡议奖"（Regulatory Initiative of the Year – Digital Assets）。这是 HashKey Exchange 首次获得该奖项，也是本届唯一获此奖项的香港持牌数字资产交易平台。

作为专注亚太地区银行及金融市场监管动态的专业媒体与研究平台，Regulation Asia 的亚洲监管卓越奖已举办至第九届，旨在表彰在监管、风险管理、合规及金融市场基础设施领域作出突出贡献的机构、团队与服务提供商。该奖项旨在表彰在亚太地区监管、风险管理、合规及金融市场基础设施领域作出突出贡献的机构、团队与服务提供商，是亚太地区监管与合规领域备受关注的行业荣誉。

多年来，HashKey Exchange 在亚洲数字资产市场深耕，率先将合规作为核心发展路径，为香港建设国际数字资产中心提供了可落地、可复制的实践样本。本次获奖，是业界对 HashKey Exchange 在监管合规领域长期投入与实践成果的肯定，也体现了其在亚洲数字资产监管生态中的重要地位。未来，HashKey Exchange 将继续落实「亚洲互联」战略，拓展与完善机构网络，深化与亚洲各地监管机构、金融机构及行业伙伴的协作，推动亚洲数字资产市场健康、有序、可持续发展。

items.content:
OpenAI让产品主管Tibo牵头安全整改，四分之一工程师转去补漏洞

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI 开始大规模整顿内部安全，负责产品开发的高管 Thibault Sottiaux（Tibo）亲自牵头。今年 8 月，他调动了约四分之一的生产工程师，专门负责修补内部系统的安全漏洞。

11 月 2 日，OpenAI 又宣布启动新一轮安全测试，与网络安全公司 Cathedral 合作，利用自家模型和外部安全研究员共同寻找系统漏洞。同时，公司将严重漏洞的悬赏奖金提高到原来的 4 倍以上。

这次整改的原因，是 OpenAI 多年来一直没有解决好的内部安全问题。路透社采访的 5 名知情人士透露，早在 ChatGPT 发布前，员工就多次向管理层和董事会提出警告，认为公司内部资料开放范围太大，安全检查也不够严格。

当时，OpenAI 将大量项目代码放在同一个仓库里。只要员工拥有访问权限，就能看到许多与自己工作无关的项目代码。部分研究资料也曾放在 GitHub 和 Slack，一些内部测试工具甚至缺少定期安全检查。员工担心，这样的管理方式会让外部黑客，甚至外国政府更容易接触到公司的核心技术。

早在 2023 年，OpenAI 内部就发生过数据泄露事件。一名黑客入侵了公司的 Slack，窃取了 GPT-4 模型的技术细节。OpenAI 后来解释，黑客进入的只是普通员工都能访问的内部频道。

今年 7 月，安全公司 Hacktron AI 的三名研究员又利用 Anthropic 的模型，攻破了多名 OpenAI 员工的 ChatGPT 账号，并进入包括公司代码仓库在内的部分内部系统。

更广为人知的是今年 10 月的一起内部案件。美国司法部指控一名沙特籍 OpenAI 工程师在公司高管会议室安装隐藏录音设备。他还曾利用内部 AI 工具查询高管访问沙特的行程，以及哪些高管可能参加与沙特部长的会议。司法部文件还显示，他曾与一名试图招募他参与沙特 AI 项目的王室成员保持联系。

多起事件接连暴露，也让员工多年前提出的安全警告再次受到关注。OpenAI 过去更强调研发速度和信息开放，如今开始收紧内部权限、加强安全检查，并投入大量工程师修补漏洞。

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 6 日，HTX DeepThink 专栏作者、HTX Research 研究员 Chloe 分析指出，本周全球风险资产的剧烈波动，主要源于市场对 AI 产业链投资回报周期的重新评估。民主党在中期选举中赢得参众两院多数席位，市场起初将其解读为政治不确定性消退，美股与加密资产短暂反弹，但投资者随即重新聚焦高利率环境与企业盈利兑现能力，风险偏好迅速逆转。

11 月 5 日，标普 500 指数收于 7,353.73 点，道琼斯指数单日下跌约 3.44%，VIX 升至 28.18，纳斯达克与大型科技股抛压明显。大型科技公司持续扩大数据中心与算力支出，自由现金流压力与收入变现速度之间的矛盾逐渐显现，叠加十年期美债收益率维持在接近 5% 的高位，成长股估值空间进一步收窄，资金关注点正转向盈利质量与资本效率。

加密市场同步承压。BTC 本周一度跌至 76,000 美元附近，选举结果公布后反弹突破 80,000 美元，11 月 5 日又回落至 75,700 美元附近，ETH 跌至 2,250 美元附近，24 小时衍生品清算规模一度超过 10 亿美元。BTC 现货 ETF 持续出现阶段性流出，11 月 3 日单日净流出约 3.99 亿美元，机构增量资金不足以吸收杠杆去化与减仓带来的卖压。BTC 与美股科技板块的相关性再度增强，未能在股市下跌时体现独立的避险属性。

下周，11 月 10 日公布的美国 CPI 将成为关键催化剂。若通胀低于预期、美债收益率回落，科技股与加密资产有望出现超跌反弹；若通胀维持粘性，高估值板块可能继续承压。短期内标普 500 预计在 7,200—7,600 点区间震荡，BTC 重点关注 75,000 美元支撑与 80,000—82,000 美元阻力。整体判断维持谨慎中性，ETF 资金能否恢复净流入、科技股能否企稳，将决定市场能否重建持续的风险偏好。

美股抛售推动资金转向美债，交易员押注收益率进一步下行

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 6 日，在周五美国 10 月就业报告公布前，债券交易员已押注美国国债市场将进一步上涨，市场对美联储继续加息的预期则持续降温。美国中期选举后全球股市遭遇抛售，推动投资者本周转向美国国债避险，10 年期美债收益率周四跌至 9 月初以来最低水平。

随着股市抛售进一步加剧，10 年期美债收益率周五报 4.82%。近期债券市场的上涨增强了交易员对收益率进一步下降的信心。期权市场的一笔交易押注，10 年期美债收益率可能在下周末降至 4.7%；另一笔将于 11 月 20 日到期的交易则押注收益率降至约 4.35%。

道明证券美国利率策略主管 Gennadiy Goldberg 表示，预计周五公布的数据将略显疲软，但市场仍主要关注经济基本面。他指出，美国经济依然相当强劲，劳动力市场呈现「低招聘、低裁员」状态，因此过去几周市场已经大幅削减了加息预期。

尼日利亚央行发非证券类虚拟资产监管规定，外币稳定币须本地持牌发行

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 6 日，尼日利亚央行发布《尼日利亚非证券类虚拟资产运营监管规定》，对稳定币、存款货币代币及相关虚拟资产服务商的发行、兑换、托管、支付等活动建立许可框架；证券类虚拟资产仍由尼日利亚证券交易委员会监管。

规定将稳定币分为奈拉稳定币与外币稳定币两类。外币稳定币须由在尼日利亚注册并持有相应发行牌照的实体发行，经央行批准后方可向当地用户提供，外国牌照不能替代。两类发行方最低实缴资本分别为 100 亿奈拉与 150 亿奈拉，约合 741 万美元与 1112 万美元；其他服务商为 10 亿奈拉，约合 74 万美元。稳定币须 1:1 足额储备并另设 2% 超额抵押，持有者可在下一工作日内按面值赎回；发行方不得向持有者支付利息或收益；算法稳定币及主要以加密资产为储备的法币稳定币被禁止。现有运营商须在规定生效后 180 天内申请牌照，并在 30 天内向央行登记，过渡期内只能维持现有业务规模，P2P 交易平台同样适用。

Cursor开始和Lovable抢生意：AI生成应用，数据库、登录和部署全包

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Cursor 推出 Live Apps，现在用户只需描述需求，云端 Agent 就能直接搭建可运行的网页应用。它会按需创建 Postgres 数据库，配置基于 Cursor SSO 的身份验证，并准备托管环境。应用完成后，用户可以预览、选择域名，通过安全检查并确认发布，最终获得一个可以分享的在线链接。

Cursor 官方列出的应用场景包括活动报名、工位安排、销售数据看板、新员工培训和工程服务门户。团队可以把应用分享给指定成员或整个组织，访问者通过 Cursor 账号登录。

发布前，系统还会检查代码中是否存在 API 密钥、暴露凭证等安全问题。团队管理员可以查看所有应用、设置安全规则，也能随时撤下已发布的应用。

Lovable 本身也支持通过自然语言生成带数据库、用户注册和托管的完整应用。Cursor 则把这套能力接进了原有的编程 Agent，除了从零搭建，还能直接部署 Cursor Origin 和 GitHub 上已有的代码仓库。对于已经在 Cursor 中开发项目的团队，现在可以直接在同一套工具里完成开发和上线。

目前 Live Apps 仅支持 Cloud Agents，本地 Agent 暂不支持。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra
items.content:
Zcash NU7 upgrade goes live, leaves 12,224 ZEC stranded in Sprout pool
Zcash’s NU7 upgrade has rendered about $15 million in legacy Sprout funds unspendable, although a future network upgrade could potentially restore access.
Zcash’s NU7 network upgrade activated Friday, making about $15 millionin ZEC held in the network’s legacy Sprout shielded pool unspendable.
The upgrade took effect at block 3,543,405 at 02:34 UTC, according to blockchain tracker ZecStats, which lists the Sprout pool balance at about 12,224 ZEC.
The upgrade cuts Zcash’s target time between blocks from 75 seconds to 25, although actual block intervals will adjust toward the new target as mining difficulty changes.
Under Zcash Improvement Proposal (ZIP) 2003, NU7 rejects version 4 transactions, the only format that supports spending Sprout funds. The remaining coins cannot be transferred under the new rules, but have not been burned.
The specification leaves open the possibility that a future network upgrade could restore access, either by re-enabling version 4 transactions or introducing another mechanism to retrieve the funds. However, it warns that “the ability to spend Sprout funds may never be re-enabled.”
NU7 also introduces a Network Sustainability Mechanism that removes 60% of transaction fees from circulation for eventual reissuance through future mining rewards, starting around February 2031.
The upgrade preserves Zcash’s 21 million ZEC supply cap and halving schedule, while introducing limits on shielded activity designed to reduce wallet synchronization demands.
Related: Zcash grants group offers $124M compromise as governance backlash grows
items.title: Zcash NU7 upgrade goes live, leaves 12,224 ZEC stranded in Sprout pool

Aina发布399美元AI戒指：预判下一步操作，拇指一拨就能批准Agent干活

动察 Beating AI 快讯，硬件初创公司 Aina 发布一款带屏幕的 AI 戒指。它最大的亮点是让用户直接在手指上批准 AI Agent 的操作，不用反复掏出手机、打开 App 点击确认。

Aina 会根据用户的日程、位置和日常习惯，预测接下来可能需要的三项操作，并在戒指屏幕上显示最相关的一项。比如每天早上 8 点半打车上班，到点就会主动提示叫车；开会快迟到了，它会建议让 Agent 代发通知。用户只需用拇指拨动戒指上的微型摇杆，就能批准或忽略操作，屏幕还会显示执行结果。

戒指配有 OLED 屏幕、麦克风和扬声器。除了控制 Agent，还能语音记笔记、接打电话、控制音乐，以及根据 Mac 当前打开的软件切换快捷操作，比如会议静音、开关摄像头。

创始人 Apoorv Shankar 其实是智能戒指领域的老玩家。2017 年，他创办硬件公司 LazyCo，2019 年就推出过第一代 Aina Ring，尝试用戒指控制手机、叫车和智能家居，并在 Kickstarter 上筹集了近 4 万美元。

2022 年，智能戒指公司 Ultrahuman 收购 LazyCo，Shankar 随后担任 Ultrahuman 硬件副总裁。离开后，他再次创业成立 Aina。这次他把早年研究的戒指交互方式进一步延伸到了 AI Agent。

类似的产品还有 Pebble Index 01、Sandbar Stream 等，但主要侧重语音记录。Aina 则把主动预测、可视化确认和跨应用操作结合起来，希望让戒指成为 AI Agent 的随身控制入口。

戒指首批预售价为 399 美元，常规标价 499 美元，计划于 2027 年 1 月开始发货。

不用越狱、不在iPhone安装App，开源项目Poki让AI直接操作你的iPhone

动察 Beating AI 快讯，开发者 Joseph Zhou 开源了 Poki，让 Codex、Claude Code 等 AI Agent 直接操控真实 iPhone。

现在已经有不少 iPhone Use 项目，有的通过 XCTest/WDA 安装测试程序，有的依靠外接硬件模拟操作。

Poki 采用了另一条路线：直接调用苹果的设备开发者服务，读取 iPhone 原生无障碍控件树，获取按钮、文字和位置，再向手机发送点击、滑动、输入甚至双指缩放等指令。

这样 AI 不必每一步都靠截图猜坐标，也不用在 iPhone 上安装测试程序。首次通过 USB 配对后，还能在同一局域网内无线操作。

除了通过 MCP 接入 Codex、Claude Code，Poki 还自带运行在 Mac 上的 Agent，可以通过终端或 iMessage 下达任务。它能记住成功执行并验证过的操作流程，下次遇到相同任务时直接复用，部分任务甚至不需要再次调用模型。不过，Mac 仍需保持运行。

真机操作目前还比较慢。作者在一台运行 iOS 27.3 的 iPhone 上测试，针对聊天 App 中一个搜索框，文字点击连续 12 次全部生效，但单次约需 8 秒；填写输入框约需 15 秒，部分按钮仍然无法正常点击。

Poki 的优势是能直接读取系统控件，支持无线操作和多点触控，但需要完整 Xcode、开发者模式及 UI Automation。底层依赖苹果的开发者接口，未来系统升级也可能影响兼容性。

Hyperliquid Strategies seeks futures registration for perps
The HYPE treasury company spent $785 million on tokens during the quarter and wants to bring Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the US.
A subsidiary of Nasdaq-listed HYPE treasury company Hyperliquid Strategies has applied to become a futures commission merchant (FCM), seeking to bring Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the US.
“Owning HYPE is how we aim to capture economics associated with the Hyperliquid protocol; setting up an FCM is how we intend to help bring markets deployed on Hyperliquid onshore,” said Hyperliquid Strategies CEO David Schamis in the company’s results for the quarter ended Sept. 30, published on Thursday.
Hyperliquid’s HIP-3 framework allows independent operators to launch custom perpetual futures markets on the protocol’s onchain infrastructure by staking 500,000 HYPE tokens ($38.8 million). Proposed HIP-3 features would allow operators to create permissioned markets that restrict participation to approved addresses.
The subsidiary would handle US customer accounts for permissioned markets deployed on Hyperliquid, the company said. Both the FCM application and the proposed markets require regulatory approval.
Intercontinental Exchange, the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange, announced an agreement with Trade[XYZ] on Oct. 29 to bring Hyperliquid-based perpetual markets to the US, subject to regulatory approvals. ICE plans to operate a dedicated market and clearing structure.
Related: Hyperliquid, Pump.fun account for nearly 90% of record $638M crypto buybacks: FT
Hyperliquid Strategies buys $785M in HYPE, spends $17M on share buybacks
During the quarter, Hyperliquid Strategies raised $911 million in equity capital. It spent $785 million to acquire 9.1 million HYPE and $17 million to repurchase 2.7 million PURR shares. The company held a total of 38.5 million HYPE as of Sept. 30, valued at $3.5 billion at the time.
“Hyperliquid is winning the parts of onchain finance that generate real fees, and nearly all of that value flows back to HYPE holders through programmatic buybacks,” Schamis said.
Hyperliquid Strategies (PURR) stock, 1-year chart. Source: Yahoo Finance
Hyperliquid Strategies’ shares fell 9.6% Thursday, closing at $8.76, according to Yahoo Finance.

Robinhood联创：目标是成为RWA与Meme领域的首选公链

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 6 日，Robinhood 联合创始人兼 CEO Vlad Tenev 在 X 平台发起一场约 45 分钟的公开 AMA，以「Let's talk Robinhood Chain」为主题，直接与开发者和社区互动，分享 Robinhood Chain 最新进展与长期愿景。

在 AMA 中，Vlad Tenev 明确表示，股票代币已在 Robinhood Chain 上线，并开放给开发者构建，同时强调「这只是开始，更多内容即将分享」。他指出，股票代币是链上独特的基础构建模块，且完全 permissionless，任何人都可以围绕它们进行开发；AI Agents 已可直接与股票代币交互。

谈及为什么要自建公链时，Vlad 表示，团队在深入调研现有生态后认为，没有任何一条链能完全满足他们的特定需求。Robinhood Chain 的目标是成为现实世界资产（RWA）与 Meme 领域的首选链。他进一步强调，RWA 与加密资产正在融合并终将成为一体，这将为整个赛道带来数量级增长的机会。

在产品侧，Vlad 透露，Robinhood 已开始在多个产品表面展示链上内容，包括在 Robinhood Wallet 中提供 dApp 浏览器与 trending Robinhood Chain 代币；主 App 的搜索与 Crypto 板块也已上线热门代币展示。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz
items.content:
Bitcoin, Ether ETFs post $530M outflows as election gains evaporate
US spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs shed a combined $530 million Thursday as Bitcoin fell below $76,000 and US stocks tumbled.
US spot Bitcoin and Ether exchange-traded funds (ETFs) posted about $530 million in net outflows Thursday as cryptocurrency markets fell sharply.
Bitcoin (BTC) ETFs recorded $430 million in net outflows while Ether (ETH) funds lost around $100 million, according to SoSoValue data.
The reversal followed $128 million in combined inflows Wednesday, when Bitcoin briefly climbed above $80,000 after Democrats’ victories in the US midterm elections.
Bitcoin fell back below $76,000 and the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite plunged 5.5% on Thursday, which was its biggest single-day decline since April 2025, according to Reuters.
Fidelity leads Bitcoin ETF outflows
Fidelity’s Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC) led Thursday’s withdrawals with roughly $200 million in outflows after attracting around $237 million on Wednesday, according to Farside Investors data.
BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) recorded another $105 million in net outflows. The latest withdrawals extended IBIT’s outflow streak to five consecutive sessions, with more than $1 billion withdrawn since Oct. 30.
Bitcoin ETFs’ year-to-date net outflows stood at around $510 million following Thursday’s closing bell.
Analysts weigh outlook after market sell-off
Crypto analyst Michaël van de Poppe said on X Thursday that Bitcoin could find a near-term bottom Friday, potentially after dipping below $75,000, pointing to the severity of the Nasdaq’s decline.
“I expect Nasdaq to bottom tomorrow. The same for Bitcoin, potentially after sweeping $75,000,” he wrote.
Dean Lyulkin, CEO of Cardiff and founder of investment publication The Dean’s List, said the current market environment differs from the period leading up to the 2008 financial crisis.
Related: Bitcoin crashes 6% to 7-week low as US stocks erase election gains
“The global financial crisis wasn’t caused by Democrats taking Congress,” Lyulkin said in comments shared with Cointelegraph, noting that the Federal Reserve had already raised interest rates substantially and the housing market was weakening before the crisis.
While acknowledging vulnerabilities in commercial real estate, private credit and potentially excessive artificial intelligence spending, Lyulkin argued that household balance sheets and the banking system are considerably stronger today.

items.content:
Alpine警示OpenSSH密码认证可被一键绕过

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 6 日，据 Alpine Linux 官方安全通告，其 openssh-server 包在未启用 PAM 的构建下存在密码认证绕过：攻击者只要能连上 SSH 端口，在特定条件下可一次连接、无需正确密码完成登录。条件包括开启 PasswordAuthentication、存在密码字段为 * 的账户，以及本机至少还有一个带 $5$ 或 $6$ 哈希的账户；攻击者对无密码账户提交超长口令即可匹配成功。受影响范围覆盖官方核查过的 Alpine 3.21–3.24 与 edge，以及已停更的 3.16–3.20；使用 openssh-server-pam 且 UsePAM yes、或已关闭密码登录的系统不受影响。

截至发稿时尚未分配 CVE。官方称根因与无 PAM 时借用其他账户盐值、以及 musl 的 crypt() 对超长口令返回 * 有关；OpenSSH 10.6p2 与各稳定分支补丁包已修复。建议立即 apk upgrade 并重启 sshd，仅升级包不会替换正在运行的守护进程；暂无法升级时应关闭密码认证。官方 tiny-cloud 镜像中的 alpine 用户带 * 口令且可无密码 doas，一旦本机出现 $6$ 哈希即可能被利用至 root。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/375945
items.title: Alpine警示OpenSSH密码认证可被一键绕过

Anthropic IPO遇冷：投资者要求估值降至1万亿，10月年化收入刚突破800亿美元

动察 Beating AI 快讯，科技股大跌后，Anthropic 的 IPO 开始面临估值压力。《华尔街日报》报道，三名计划参与 IPO 的大型机构投资者认为，此前预期的 1.5 万亿美元估值仍然偏高，其中一人认为应该降至约 1 万亿美元。

但 Anthropic 的收入还在快速增长。知情人士透露，截至 10 月底，公司的年化收入运行率已经超过 800 亿美元。此前这一数字在 7 月底刚超过 650 亿美元，三个月内又提高了一个台阶。

投资者对上市方案也有不同意见。有人想先看完 10 月财报，再决定是否接受估值下调；一名投资者认为，Anthropic 可以把募资规模从此前预期的 1000 亿美元降至约 800 亿美元；还有投资者提出，如果市场持续低迷，不如推迟上市，等行情好转再发。

这些都只是潜在买家向公司释放的意见，最终决定权仍在 Anthropic 及其承销商手中。但如果大型机构不愿按照原来的估值认购，Anthropic 就不得不重新考虑发行价格、募资规模，甚至上市时间。

items.author: ppmpreetham
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[munksbeer]: Can I please congratulate you on your README. It rapidly tells me what I'm looking at, and why I might be interested in the project. There are so many READMEs around that ... just don't do that. They ramble about technical implementation details, and a third of the way through the README, I'm still left wonder, "but what does this project do?".

[lukebitts]: That's really cool! I burned some tokens trying to develop something similar but gave up halfway. A lot of people criticize Blender's UI but as someone who has been using blender for more than a decade now I just find it so elegant. Just the customizability itself is something I miss on most 3D software, if not all of them. Being able to just split screens and change their functionality, paired with the tabs for different workflows, it is a really good solution for a very complex so...

[dev0p]: I love the general idea behind Blender's UI. And I do appreciate the effort that goes into it, especially in the latest versions as it got much better, But I really really really REALLY don't want that UI in anything else other than Blender. Please don't.

[xlii]: Others have noted that GPLv3 is required (which is a show stopper for many) but I'd like to mention that I find the pill saying "GPLv2 or Later" in the project itself misleading. Especially since v2 and v3 have vastly different consequences.

[nicoburns]: For anyone looking at Rust GUI: don't expect GPUI to be the fastest. From what I've heard, Iced, Slint, Dioxus Native, Freya, etc are all faster. Despite claims of being blazingly fast, GPUI isn't that optimized. Zed gets away with it because it's UI is simple.

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
蚂蚁Ling-3.2-flash升级原生视觉：560B旗舰能看图操作Blender、做3D

动察 Beating AI 快讯，蚂蚁百灵发布 Ling-3.2-flash，将原生多模态能力带入 560B 旗舰模型。新模型支持图像、文本和视频输入，重点强化复杂视觉理解、3D 交互和多模态 Agent 能力。

新模型沿用上一代 Ling-3.1-flash 的 5600 亿总参数、250 亿激活参数和 100 万 Token 上下文，但从文本推理进一步扩展到原生视觉理解。此前的 Ling-3.0-flash-VL 已支持图像和视频输入，但规模只有 1240 亿总参数、55 亿激活参数，上下文为 25.6 万 Token。

官方演示中，新模型可以根据图片制作网页，操作 Blender 创建 3D 场景，还能读取包含公式和图表的论文 PDF，将其中的算法写成可运行的代码。

I looked around, had some interviews, had some offers. None of the postings had salary ranges, as is common where I live. My eyes, however, were set on a specific small company because I liked their product. The process was long and involved multiple meeting...

[aregue]: I have always felt that job ads should include salary information. The main reason is not to waste anyone's time. Often a narrow salary range or a clear link between requirements and salary are much more informative than a job description. I have experienced to apply to a job opening and go through one or more interviews only to find out that the company is actually hiring for a more junior position than the ad copy implied. A second reason is to avoid discrimination. Applicants that fee...

[ellen364]: Cautiously pleased about this. Some companies in UK pay senior devs £30-35k. And some companies won't discuss that until v late in the process, while importing US-style multiround interviews. It's pretty silly when people get 3 rounds in, take time off work for the interviews, then find out their expectations are so far apart.

[claw-el]: Besides ‘salary disclosure’, one other law that really helps improve salary is to ban potential employers from asking candidates’ current/previous salary. This avoids potential employers from offering just marginally better than candidates previous roles…

[sjamaan]: > The European  Union adopted pay transparency rules the  following year, giving member states until June 2026 to implement them in national  law. That's the first I've heard of it, and I've seen plenty of job postings the past year for European companies where there was no salary indication. 隔夜布伦特原油期货暴跌近 9%，跌破每桶 100 美元，本周累计跌幅约 20%；若跌势持续至周五收盘，将录得 2020 年 4 月以来最大单周跌幅。亚洲早盘油价在约 93.50 美元附近考验隔夜低点。能源价格回落带动债券上涨、收益率下行，欧元兑美元升至约 1.1273，美元触及约一个月低点，并支撑股市。标普 500 指数收涨 1.6%，欧洲股市触及约两个月高位；太阳能产业链涨幅居前，市场预期民主党将加大可再生能源支持。

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI 前 CTO Mira Murati 创办的 Thinking Machines 发布新模型 Inkling 2 Small。Artificial Analysis 综合评分达到 31 分，上一代只有 13 分，成为美国得分最高的开源模型。

模型名字叫 Small，实际却有 5940 亿总参数，每次推理激活 170 亿。提升最大的是 Agent 能力。自动化任务通过率从 5% 涨到 46%，编程测试成绩从 5% 涨到 25%，但仍略低于 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 的 28.5%。Thinking Machines 主要靠强化学习提升模型处理复杂任务的能力。

Artificial Analysis 测试发现，模型平均每项任务要输出约 15 万 Token，是上一代的 4 倍。平均花费从 0.20 美元涨到 1.18 美元，完成一项任务约需 21 分钟。

目前，Inkling 2 Small 已在 Tinker 开放推理和微调。完整权重还没发布，官方计划下周完成外部安全测试后，以 Apache 2.0 许可证开源。
